interval '1 year'))) as cap_ly, sum(rm.beds_per_room) filter (where rcc.date >= make_date($CY,1,1) and rcc.date < make_date($CY+1,1,1)) as cap_cfy, sum(rm.beds_per_room) filter (where rcc.date >= make_date($LY,1,1) and rcc.date < make_date($LY+1,1,1)) as cap_lfy from room_capacity_calendar rcc join properties pxr on pxr.id=rcc.property_uuid join calendar cxr on cxr.date=rcc.date join rooms rm on rm.id=rcc.room_id where rcc.company_id='7808b663-735b-46ab-b4ae-80ec4c14c61a' and rcc.status='open' and (rcc.date >= make_date($LY,1,1) and rcc.date < make_date($CY+1,1,1))),
raw as (
  select (bn_cy::numeric/nullif(cap_cy,0))::float8 cy, (bn_ly::numeric/nullif(cap_ly,0))::float8 ly, (bn_cfy::numeric/nullif(cap_cfy,0))::float8 cfy, (bn_lfy::numeric/nullif(cap_lfy,0))::float8 lfy from nx, capx
), v as (
  select cy, ly, cfy, lfy, 0.95*cfy as tgt from raw
)
select '% Ocupación' as lbl, cy, ly, tgt, cfy as fy,
  replace(round(abs((cy-ly)*100)::numeric,1)::text,'.',',')||'pp' as yoytxt,
  case when (cy-ly) < 0 then '▼' else '▲' end as arrow,
  case when (cy-ly) < 0 then '#A0453D' else '#56B14E' end as yoycolor,
  (case when (cy-tgt)>=0 then '+' else '-' end)||replace(round(abs((cy-tgt)*100)::numeric,1)::text,'.',',')||'pp' as pcttgt,
  case when (cy-tgt)*100>=-1 then '#56B14E' when (cy-tgt)*100>=-3 then '#E0A800' else '#A0453D' end as tgtcolor,
  case case when (cy-tgt)*100>=-1 then '#56B14E' when (cy-tgt)*100>=-3 then '#E0A800' else '#A0453D' end when '#56B14E' then '#2F7A34' when '#E0A800' then '#B7860B' else '#A0453D' end as tgttext,
  case case when (cy-tgt)*100>=-1 then '#56B14E' when (cy-tgt)*100>=-3 then '#E0A800' else '#A0453D' end when '#56B14E' then '#E9F5EA' when '#E0A800' then '#FCF3DA' else '#FBECEA' end as tgtbg,
  least(100,greatest(0, cy/nullif(tgt,0)*100))::int as barw,
  least(100,greatest(0, cfy/nullif(lfy,0)*100))::int as fybarw,
  (case when (cfy-lfy)>=0 then '+' else '-' end)||replace(round(abs((cfy-lfy)*100)::numeric,1)::text,'.',',')||'pp' as fypct
from v

  bk as (select booking_ref, max(total_nights) filter (where dci >= make_date($CY,1,1) and dci < make_date($CY+1,1,1) and (not ($CY = extract(year from current_date)) or dci <= current_date)) los_cy, avg(lead_time_days) filter (where dci >= make_date($CY,1,1) and dci < make_date($CY+1,1,1) and (not ($CY = extract(year from current_date)) or dci <= current_date)) lt_cy, max(g) filter (where dci >= make_date($CY,1,1) and dci < make_date($CY+1,1,1) and (not ($CY = extract(year from current_date)) or dci <= current_date)) grupo_cy, min(canc) filter (where dci >= make_date($CY,1,1) and dci < make_date($CY+1,1,1) and (not ($CY = extract(year from current_date)) or dci <= current_date)) cancel_cy, max(isdorm) filter (where dci >= make_date($CY,1,1) and dci < make_date($CY+1,1,1) and (not ($CY = extract(year from current_date)) or dci <= current_date)) dorm_cy, count(*) filter (where dci >= make_date($CY,1,1) and dci < make_date($CY+1,1,1) and (not ($CY = extract(year from current_date)) or dci <= current_date)) n_cy, max(total_nights) filter (where dci >= make_date($LY,1,1) and dci < make_date($LY+1,1,1) and (not ($CY = extract(year from current_date)) or dci <= (current_date - interval '1 year'))) los_ly, avg(lead_time_days) filter (where dci >= make_date($LY,1,1) and dci < make_date($LY+1,1,1) and (not ($CY = extract(year from current_date)) or dci <= (current_date - interval '1 year'))) lt_ly, max(g) filter (where dci >= make_date($LY,1,1) and dci < make_date($LY+1,1,1) and (not ($CY = extract(year from current_date)) or dci <= (current_date - interval '1 year'))) grupo_ly, min(canc) filter (where dci >= make_date($LY,1,1) and dci < make_date($LY+1,1,1) and (not ($CY = extract(year from current_date)) or dci <= (current_date - interval '1 year'))) cancel_ly, max(isdorm) filter (where dci >= make_date($LY,1,1) and dci < make_date($LY+1,1,1) and (not ($CY = extract(year from current_date)) or dci <= (current_date - interval '1 year'))) dorm_ly, count(*) filter (where dci >= make_date($LY,1,1) and dci < make_date($LY+1,1,1) and (not ($CY = extract(year from current_date)) or dci <= (current_date - interval '1 year'))) n_ly, max(total_nights) filter (where dci >= make_date($CY,1,1) and dci < make_date($CY+1,1,1)) los_cfy, avg(lead_time_days) filter (where dci >= make_date($CY,1,1) and dci < make_date($CY+1,1,1)) lt_cfy, max(g) filter (where dci >= make_date($CY,1,1) and dci < make_date($CY+1,1,1)) grupo_cfy, min(canc) filter (where dci >= make_date($CY,1,1) and dci < make_date($CY+1,1,1)) cancel_cfy, max(isdorm) filter (where dci >= make_date($CY,1,1) and dci < make_date($CY+1,1,1)) dorm_cfy, count(*) filter (where dci >= make_date($CY,1,1) and dci < make_date($CY+1,1,1)) n_cfy, max(total_nights) filter (where dci >= make_date($LY,1,1) and dci < make_date($LY+1,1,1)) los_lfy, avg(lead_time_days) filter (where dci >= make_date($LY,1,1) and dci < make_date($LY+1,1,1)) lt_lfy, max(g) filter (where dci >= make_date($LY,1,1) and dci < make_date($LY+1,1,1)) grupo_lfy, min(canc) filter (where dci >= make_date($LY,1,1) and dci < make_date($LY+1,1,1)) cancel_lfy, max(isdorm) filter (where dci >= make_date($LY,1,1) and dci < make_date($LY+1,1,1)) dorm_lfy, count(*) filter (where dci >= make_date($LY,1,1) and dci < make_date($LY+1,1,1)) n_lfy from rowsc group by booking_ref),
raw as (select (avg(lt_cy) filter (where n_cy>0 and cancel_cy=0 and grupo_cy=0 and dorm_cy=1))::float8 cy, (avg(lt_ly) filter (where n_ly>0 and cancel_ly=0 and grupo_ly=0 and dorm_ly=1))::float8 ly, (avg(lt_cfy) filter (where n_cfy>0 and cancel_cfy=0 and grupo_cfy=0 and dorm_cfy=1))::float8 cfy, (avg(lt_lfy) filter (where n_lfy>0 and cancel_lfy=0 and grupo_lfy=0 and dorm_lfy=1))::float8 lfy from bk),
v as (select cy, ly, cfy, lfy, 0.95*cfy as tgt from raw)
select 'Lead time · Dorms' as lbl, cy, ly, tgt, cfy as fy,
  replace(round((abs(cy/nullif(ly,0)-1)*100)::numeric,1)::text,'.',',')||'%' as yoytxt,
  case when (cy/nullif(ly,0)-1) < 0 then '▼' else '▲' end as arrow,
  case when (cy/nullif(ly,0)-1) < 0 then '#A0453D' else '#56B14E' end as yoycolor,
  (case when cy/nullif(tgt,0)-1>=0 then '+' else '-' end)||replace(round((abs(cy/nullif(tgt,0)-1)*100)::numeric,1)::text,'.',',')||'%' as pcttgt,
  case when cy/nullif(tgt,0)>0.96 then '#56B14E' when cy/nullif(tgt,0)>=0.9 then '#E0A800' else '#A0453D' end as tgtcolor,
  case case when cy/nullif(tgt,0)>0.96 then '#56B14E' when cy/nullif(tgt,0)>=0.9 then '#E0A800' else '#A0453D' end when '#56B14E' then '#2F7A34' when '#E0A800' then '#B7860B' else '#A0453D' end as tgttext,
  case case when cy/nullif(tgt,0)>0.96 then '#56B14E' when cy/nullif(tgt,0)>=0.9 then '#E0A800' else '#A0453D' end when '#56B14E' then '#E9F5EA' when '#E0A800' then '#FCF3DA' else '#FBECEA' end as tgtbg,
  least(100,greatest(0, cy/nullif(tgt,0)*100))::int as barw,
  least(100,greatest(0, cfy/nullif(lfy,0)*100))::int as fybarw,
  (case when cfy/nullif(lfy,0)-1>=0 then '+' else '-' end)||replace(round((abs(cfy/nullif(lfy,0)-1)*100)::numeric,1)::text,'.',',')||'%' as fypct
from v

  xb as (select coalesce((select rc.display_name from room_categories rc where rc.company_id=r.company_id and rc.raw_value=r.room_category_raw limit 1), r.room_category_raw, '(Sin categoría)') cat, coalesce(ch.channel_type,'(Sin canal)') s, sum(e.units*c.unit_price_gross) prodex from extras e join properties pxe on pxe.property_id=e.property_id and pxe.company_id=e.company_id join extras_catalog c on c.company_id=e.company_id and c.raw_value=e.raw_value join reservations r on r.company_id=e.company_id and r.reservation_uid=e.reservation_uid join calendar cxe on cxe.date=(case when c.revenue_timing='at_checkout' then r.date_check_out else r.date_check_in end) left join channels ch on ch.company_id=r.company_id and ch.raw_value=r.reservation_source where e.company_id='7808b663-735b-46ab-b4ae-80ec4c14c61a' and not coalesce(c.is_passthrough,false) and (case when c.revenue_timing='at_checkout' then r.date_check_out else r.date_check_in end) >= make_date($CY,1,1) and (case when c.revenue_timing='at_checkout' then r.date_check_out else r.date_check_in end) < make_date($CY+1,1,1) group by 1,2),

with nb as (select coalesce(o.display_name, r.ota) d, coalesce((select rc.display_name from room_categories rc where rc.company_id=n.company_id and rc.raw_value=n.room_category_raw limit 1), n.room_category_raw, '(Sin categoría)') cat, sum(n.price) prodacc, sum(case when n.bed_code_raw is null or n.bed_code_raw='' then rm.beds_per_room else 1 end) bn from nights n join properties pxn on pxn.property_id=n.property_id and pxn.company_id=n.company_id join calendar cxn on cxn.date=n.stay_date join reservations r on r.company_id=n.company_id and r.reservation_uid=n.reservation_uid left join rooms rm on rm.company_id=n.company_id and rm.raw_value=n.room_code_raw left join otas o on o.company_id=r.company_id and o.raw_value=r.ota where n.company_id='7808b663-735b-46ab-b4ae-80ec4c14c61a' and n.stay_date >= make_date($CY,1,1) and n.stay_date < make_date($CY+1,1,1) and r.ota is not null group by 1,2),
  xb as (select coalesce(o.display_name, r.ota) d, coalesce((select rc.display_name from room_categories rc where rc.company_id=r.company_id and rc.raw_value=r.room_category_raw limit 1), r.room_category_raw, '(Sin categoría)') cat, sum(e.units*c.unit_price_gross) prodex from extras e join properties pxe on pxe.property_id=e.property_id and pxe.company_id=e.company_id join extras_catalog c on c.company_id=e.company_id and c.raw_value=e.raw_value join reservations r on r.company_id=e.company_id and r.reservation_uid=e.reservation_uid join calendar cxe on cxe.date=(case when c.revenue_timing='at_checkout' then r.date_check_out else r.date_check_in end) left join otas o on o.company_id=r.company_id and o.raw_value=r.ota where e.company_id='7808b663-735b-46ab-b4ae-80ec4c14c61a' and not coalesce(c.is_passthrough,false) and (case when c.revenue_timing='at_checkout' then r.date_check_out else r.date_check_in end) >= make_date($CY,1,1) and (case when c.revenue_timing='at_checkout' then r.date_check_out else r.date_check_in end) < make_date($CY+1,1,1) and r.ota is not null group by 1,2),
  j as (select nb.d, nb.cat, nb.prodacc, nb.bn, coalesce(xb.prodex,0) prodex from nb left join xb on xb.d=nb.d and xb.cat=nb.cat)
select j.d as row, j.cat as col, (j.bn)::float8 v from j order by j.d, j.cat

visuals.html: Client Country Analysis

visuals.sql:
with ca as (
    select coalesce(co.country_name,'(Sin país)') country, coalesce(mg.group_name,'(Sin grupo)') market_group,
      sum(n.price) prodacc,
      sum(case when n.bed_code_raw is null or n.bed_code_raw='' then rm.beds_per_room else 1 end) bn,
      count(distinct n.reservation_uid) res
    from nights n join properties pxn on pxn.property_id=n.property_id and pxn.company_id=n.company_id join calendar cxn on cxn.date=n.stay_date join reservations r on r.company_id=n.company_id and r.reservation_uid=n.reservation_uid
      left join rooms rm on rm.company_id=n.company_id and rm.raw_value=n.room_code_raw
      left join client_country_mapping ccm on ccm.company_id=r.company_id and ccm.raw_value=r.client_country
      left join countries co on co.country_code=ccm.country_code
      left join country_mapping cm on cm.company_id=r.company_id and cm.country_code=ccm.country_code
      left join market_groups mg on mg.id=cm.market_group_id
    where n.company_id='7808b663-735b-46ab-b4ae-80ec4c14c61a' and n.stay_date >= make_date($CY,1,1) and n.stay_date < make_date($CY+1,1,1) group by 1,2),
  xa as (
    select coalesce(co.country_name,'(Sin país)') country, sum(e.units*c.unit_price_gross) prodex
    from extras e join properties pxe on pxe.property_id=e.property_id and pxe.company_id=e.company_id join extras_catalog c on c.company_id=e.company_id and c.raw_value=e.raw_value
      join reservations r on r.company_id=e.company_id and r.reservation_uid=e.reservation_uid join calendar cxe on cxe.date=(case when c.revenue_timing='at_checkout' then r.date_check_out else r.date_check_in end)
      left join client_country_mapping ccm on ccm.company_id=r.company_id and ccm.raw_value=r.client_country
      left join countries co on co.country_code=ccm.country_code
    where e.company_id='7808b663-735b-46ab-b4ae-80ec4c14c61a' and not coalesce(c.is_passthrough,false) and (case when c.revenue_timing='at_checkout' then r.date_check_out else r.date_check_in end) >= make_date($CY,1,1) and (case when c.revenue_timing='at_checkout' then r.date_check_out else r.date_check_in end) < make_date($CY+1,1,1) group by 1),
  bwa as (
    select coalesce(co.country_name,'(Sin país)') country, avg(r.lead_time_days) bw
    from reservations r
      left join client_country_mapping ccm on ccm.company_id=r.company_id and ccm.raw_value=r.client_country
      left join countries co on co.country_code=ccm.country_code
    where r.company_id='7808b663-735b-46ab-b4ae-80ec4c14c61a' and r.reservation_uid in (select distinct n.reservation_uid from nights n join properties pxn on pxn.property_id=n.property_id and pxn.company_id=n.company_id join calendar cxn on cxn.date=n.stay_date where n.company_id='7808b663-735b-46ab-b4ae-80ec4c14c61a' and n.stay_date >= make_date($CY,1,1) and n.stay_date < make_date($CY+1,1,1)) group by 1),
  captot as (select sum(rm.beds_per_room) cap from room_capacity_calendar rcc join properties pxr on pxr.id=rcc.property_uuid join calendar cxr on cxr.date=rcc.date join rooms rm on rm.id=rcc.room_id
    where rcc.company_id='7808b663-735b-46ab-b4ae-80ec4c14c61a' and rcc.status='open' and rcc.date >= make_date($CY,1,1) and rcc.date < make_date($CY+1,1,1)),
  cj as (select ca.country, ca.market_group, ca.prodacc, ca.bn, ca.res, coalesce(xa.prodex,0) prodex, bwa.bw,
      ca.prodacc+coalesce(xa.prodex,0) prodtot, (select cap from captot) cap
    from ca left join xa using(country) left join bwa using(country))
select country k, (prodtot)::float8 v, market_group from cj where country <> '(Sin país)' order by v desc nulls last

  xb as (select coalesce((select rc.display_name from room_categories rc where rc.company_id=r.company_id and rc.raw_value=r.room_category_raw limit 1), r.room_category_raw, '(Sin categoría)') cat, extract(isodow from (case when c.revenue_timing='at_checkout' then r.date_check_out else r.date_check_in end))::int d, sum(e.units*c.unit_price_gross) prodex from extras e join extras_catalog c on c.company_id=e.company_id and c.raw_value=e.raw_value join reservations r on r.company_id=e.company_id and r.reservation_uid=e.reservation_uid where e.company_id='7808b663-735b-46ab-b4ae-80ec4c14c61a' and not coalesce(c.is_passthrough,false) and (case when c.revenue_timing='at_checkout' then r.date_check_out else r.date_check_in end) >= make_date($CY,1,1) and (case when c.revenue_timing='at_checkout' then r.date_check_out else r.date_check_in end) < make_date($CY+1,1,1) group by 1,2),
  j as (select nb.cat, nb.d, trim(nb.dn) dn, nb.prodacc, nb.bn, coalesce(xb.prodex,0) prodex from nb left join xb on xb.cat=nb.cat and xb.d=nb.d)
select j.cat as row, initcap(j.dn) as col, j.d as colOrd, (j.prodacc/nullif(j.bn,0))::float8 v from j order by j.cat, j.d
